shog.definition:
n. A shock; a jog; a violent concussion or impulse.
v. t. To shake; to shock.
v. i. To jog; to move on.

shogi.translation: [网络] 将棋；日本的将棋；日本将棋

shogun.definition: n. a hereditary military dictator of Japan; the shoguns ruled Japan until the revolution of 1867-68

shogunate.definition: n a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)
shogunate.translation: n. 将军职位, 将军政治, 幕府时代

shoguns.definition:
plural of shogun
n. a hereditary military dictator of Japan; the shoguns ruled Japan until the revolution of 1867-68
shoguns.translation: (shogun 的复数) n.<日>幕府时代的将军
